verdict.rationale:
Mastra ships an extensively documented programmatic TypeScript API (createTool, createAgent, createWorkflow, memory, streaming, etc.) that AI-native users can call to drive agents and workflows, and Mastra apps can run as a server. However, a probe for a formal public REST/OpenAPI spec (openapi.json, swagger.json) returned 404 across all candidate paths, meaning there's no evidence of a documented external HTTP API contract beyond the SDK/docs.md/llms.txt.

missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST API spec or equivalent machine-readable public API contract, independent confirmation of programmatic API usage outside first-party docs.
